login.title: Login
login.subtitle: Log in to your Nafyn account
login.passkeyNeedsSecureContext: Passkeys need a secure connection - access Nafyn over HTTPS (or localhost) to use them.

auth.privacyPrefix: By creating an account you accept that this instance stores the data described in its
auth.privacyLoginPrefix: What this instance stores about you:

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.empty: No tracks in your library yet.
tracks.add: Add a track from a file

all.title: Everyone's Library
all.empty: No tracks have been downloaded yet.

albums.title: Albums
albums.empty: No albums in your library yet.

search.hint: Search by title or "Artist - Title" - in any script, or in Latin letters for a Japanese, Korean or Chinese song

requests.title: Requests
requests.deleteConfirm: Delete this request? This can't be undone.
requests.deleteBusy: This request is being processed and can't be deleted.

registerLock.title: Open registration
registerLock.closed: An access token is required to register

subsonic.title: Subsonic
subsonic.intro: Connect a Subsonic-compatible app to your Nafyn library using these details.
subsonic.passwordNote: Your regular Nafyn account password works for password-based login. For token-based login, generate an API token below and use that as the password instead.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: App passwords for third-party clients. Required for token-based Subsonic login (your real account password can't be used there); also work as a regular password.
tokens.revealWarning: Copy this now - it won't be shown again.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.unityToggleLabel: Allow other devices to remote-control playback
sessions.unityToggleHint: When on, any other device logged into your account can see and control what's playing. Turn it off to keep every device fully independent.
sessions.sessionOverrideLabel: Turn off Unity on this device for this session
sessions.intro: Every device currently logged into your account. Revoking a session signs it out immediately.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your device's fingerprint, face unlock, or security key - no password to type or remember.
passkeys.needsSecureContext: Passkeys need a secure connection: access Nafyn over HTTPS (or localhost) to use them.

history.title: Listening history
history.label: Use listening history
history.on: On - your plays are recorded and power your insights
history.note: Turning this off stops new plays being recorded straight away. It doesn't delete what's already there.

export.title: Export your data
export.note: Everything Nafyn holds about your listening, as a JSON file: raw plays, aggregates, Replay Mixes and year-end summaries.

delete.title: Delete your history
delete.note: Permanently erases every play, every statistic, every Replay Mix and every year-end summary. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirm: Permanently delete your entire listening history? This cannot be undone.
delete.done: Your listening history has been deleted.

notice.title: What this instance stores
notice.body: A plain-language account of every piece of data Nafyn keeps about you, why, and for how long.

accountExport.title: Download all your data
accountExport.note: One JSON file with everything held about your account: profile, settings, logins (including the IP addresses they came from), library, playlists, requests, recently played and all listening data. Secrets are excluded.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.note: Permanently erases your account and everything attached to it: logins, passkeys, API tokens, settings, library access, your playlists, recently played and all listening history. Audio files stay on the server if another user also has them. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirm: Permanently delete your account and all of your data? This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.lastAdmin: You are the only administrator on this instance. Grant ADMIN to another account first.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.fileSize: Show file size in track lists
appearance.fileSizeLocked: Only available to accounts with the Manage music permission.
appearance.duration: Show track duration in track lists

crossfade.title: Crossfade
crossfade.label: Crossfade between songs
crossfade.note: Songs blend into each other at the end. Consecutive tracks of the same album (track 1 into track 2, etc.) always play without a fade, as the artist sequenced them.

sampleData.title: Sample data
sampleData.label: Fill my library with sample data
sampleData.note: Loads a fixed catalog of real songs/albums/artists into your library, along with a batch of sample playlists and a year of fake (but consistent) listening history to populate Insights. Turning this off removes everything it added, including the listening history it generated. Only available in development.

webhooks.title: Your webhooks
webhooks.intro: Post your own notifications (your requests, releases you follow, and request activity if you manage requests) to Discord, Slack, ntfy, Gotify or any service that accepts a JSON POST. Webhook URLs must use https and point to a public address.

devices.title: Apple devices
devices.intro: Apple devices where the Nafyn app is signed in. Removing a device stops all of its notifications, Live Activities and Now Playing controls; signing out of the app, or revoking its session, does the same.
devices.empty: No Apple device has registered for notifications yet.

releases.title: Followed releases
releases.intro: Upcoming albums and tracks you'll be notified about at midnight, your time, on release day.
releases.empty: You don't follow any upcoming release. Open an unreleased album or track and press "Notify me".

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Instance-wide webhooks receive every request event (new, accepted, denied, completed, failed), whoever made the request. Messages include the requester's name and what they requested.

playlist.title: Playlists
playlist.tracksEmpty: This playlist has no tracks yet.

delete.confirmMessage: This will permanently delete the playlist and its cover image. Tracks stay in your library.

addTracks.title: Add tracks
addTracks.empty: Your library has no more tracks to add.

player.queueHint: Drag to reorder, or press Alt + Up/Down arrows. Delete removes the track.
player.lyricsUnavailable: No lyrics available for this track.

yearly.title: Your year
yearly.frozen: Locked in on {date}. This is how the year looked when it ended.
yearly.live: Updating as you listen. It gets locked in at the start of December.

gate.title: Not enough listening yet
gate.body: Rankings appear once you've played {tracks} different tracks or listened for {minutes} minutes.

disabled.body: Listening history is off, so there's nothing to show.

replay.subtitle: {count} tracks
replay.readOnly: Built automatically every Monday. It can't be edited.
replay.empty: This mix fills up as you listen.

reel.videoNote: A montage of the year's top tracks - album art, short audio excerpts and your headline numbers. Rendering runs in the background and takes a few minutes.

edit.title: Edit metadata
edit.label: Label
edit.lyricsPlaceholder: Paste or type the lyrics. LRC format keeps them in sync with playback.

import.title: Import music
import.hint: Add an audio file you already have and fill in its details yourself. Blank fields are taken from the file's own tags.
import.pickFile: Choose an audio file (MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV)

privacy.missing: The privacy notice could not be loaded. Ask the operator of this instance for it.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.unnamed: This instance is run by its operator.
controller.missing: The operator of this instance has not published who they are or how to reach them. Ask whoever gave you your account - under the GDPR they are the data controller and have to answer requests about your data.

upcoming.label: Out in
upcoming.subscribed: You'll be notified when it's out
